questions.question: Explain why 3/4 is bigger than 3/8.
questions.expected_answer: Both fractions have 3 pieces, but quarters are bigger pieces than eighths, because the whole is cut into fewer pieces. So 3/4 is bigger.

questions.question: Which is bigger, 2/3 or 5/6? Show how you know.
questions.expected_answer: Change 2/3 into sixths by multiplying the top and bottom by 2: 2/3 = 4/6. Now 5/6 is bigger than 4/6, so 5/6 is bigger.

questions.question: Order 1/2, 3/8, 3/4 and 5/8 from smallest to biggest.
questions.expected_answer: Write each in eighths: 1/2 = 4/8 and 3/4 = 6/8, while 3/8 and 5/8 stay the same. Ordering the numerators gives 3/8, 1/2, 5/8 and 3/4.
